items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee Herman Autrey does not mention Bach; the mention of Bach is made by the Interviewer in the context of discussing Fats Domino's music.

ctx.x: Because I've heard so much of the idea that underneath it all he was rather disappointed that his music -- he wasn't playing Bach, and --

Nah, nah, he was happy. I mean -- and he would preach that. That was his -- be happy. Do what makes you happy. I mean that was his check on own life. He would tell people, you know. "Use it." (Raspberry) don't do it. Forget it. Do what you want to do. Make yourself happy." You know. He said life is short. Life is short. Be happy." You know?
